name: GD Screen Recorder
description: Turn Geometry Dash into a <cr>cinematic</c> recording studio: <co>GD Screen Recorder</c> captures your gameplay directly in-game, exports one <cg>showcase-ready MP4</c> with <cb>three polished audio tracks</c> (Game + Mic, Game Audio, Mic Only), and powers every clip with <cy>smooth GPU-optimized capture</c>, <cp>smart encoder fallback</c>, and <cl>creator-ready hotkeys</c> for completions, showcases, highlights, and true YouTube-ready moments.

quality.name: Video Quality
quality.description: 1 = Low (small file). 2 = Medium. 3 = High. 4 = Ultra (large file)

fps.name: Recording FPS
fps.description: Frames per second. 60 = smooth, 30 = less space

encoder.name: Video Encoder
encoder.description: 1=Auto 2=NVIDIA(120fps) 3=AMD(120fps) 4=Intel(120fps) 5=x264(dynamic fps cap) 6=mpeg4(dynamic fps cap) 7=x265(30fps). CPU encoders are capped automatically by workload.

gpu-downscale.name: GPU Downscale
gpu-downscale.description: 0=Off 1=Auto 2=720p 3=540p 4=480p 5=360p. Uses GPU blit before readback when available; otherwise falls back to FFmpeg scale.

output-dir.name: Output Folder
output-dir.description: Where to save videos. Empty = GD/recordings folder

show-indicator.name: Show Indicator
show-indicator.description: Blinking REC indicator on screen. Toggle with F11

mic-enabled.name: Record Microphone
mic-enabled.description: Record microphone as a separate audio track via WASAPI endpoint capture. Press F8 in-game to select mic device from a popup list.

mic-device.name: Microphone Device
mic-device.description: Device number ("1", "2") or exact name. Press F8 in-game to pick from active devices. Empty = default mic.

mic-volume.name: Microphone Volume
mic-volume.description: Microphone volume in percent. 100 = normal, 200 = 2x louder, 50 = half. Applied during mux after recording.

game-audio-enabled.name: Record Game Audio
game-audio-enabled.description: Record game audio from Geometry Dash's FMOD mix. Uses process loopback only as a fallback if FMOD tap is unavailable.

show-unsupported-os-warning.name: Warn If Game Audio Unsupported
show-unsupported-os-warning.description: Show a warning before recording if neither the FMOD game-audio tap nor the fallback process loopback backend is available.

auto-disable-mic-on-error.name: Auto Disable Mic On Error
auto-disable-mic-on-error.description: If the microphone input fails to start, continue recording without the microphone track instead of aborting the session.

log-performance-degradation.name: Log Performance Issues
log-performance-degradation.description: Write performance warnings such as encoder backpressure, dropped frames, and PBO misses to the mod log.
